name: Dependents
job: answers: what a child changes on my return, my filing status, and my plan's dates

concepts.concept: a child changes the return and the filing status, and both change on dates

unlock.text: Always; the credits apply once a dependent is entered.

coreChanges: core change: the federal M2 return takes the child tax credit, the dependent care credit, and the QBI deduction (engine/tax/federal-m2.ts, decision A9)
core change: the timeline files head of household only while a qualifying child remains and ends a spending row on a dependent's age (engine/projection/timeline.ts, engine/projection/income.ts)
core change: the Rule of 5 counts the household's dependents for term life (engine/levels/resilience.ts)

killCriteria.measure: share of households with a dependent entered that see a different FI date or take-home because of it
killCriteria.threshold: under 50% after 90 days of beta (the credits should move nearly every such plan)
killCriteria.action: fold the fields into Level 1's About you section and drop the module
